title: Shotgun 650 Custom Bobber (Urban Commuter)
description: Representing Royal Enfield's prowess in the Performance Cruiser class, the Royal Enfield Shotgun 650 Custom Bobber (Urban Commuter) is delivers authentic heritage styling paired with modern highway mile-munching comfort. A 650cc powerplant pumps out 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With an accessible 705mm seat height that allows easy flat-footing for virtually all rider heights and a comfortable Upright Neutral layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
